title: Brown and Perdue join Eastern Illinois women's basketball coaching staff
text:
Brown and Perdue join Eastern Illinois women’s basketball coaching staff
Eastern Illinois University women's basketball head coach Marqus McGlothan announced on June 3 the addition of Myron Brown and Mickayla Perdue as assistant coaches for the Panthers' 2026-27 season.
Brown joins the staff with experience at multiple collegiate levels, most recently serving on the coaching staff at New Mexico State University. While there, he contributed to developing a second team All-Conference USA selection. Brown has also held assistant coaching positions at Oakland University and North Florida, both NCAA Division I programs. His background includes five years as head coach at Thomas University in Georgia, a member of the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics.
Perdue arrives at Eastern Illinois after completing her playing career as a graduate student at the University of Arizona. She was recognized twice as an All-Horizon League player while competing for Cleveland State and received Horizon League Player of the Year honors in 2025. Perdue's collegiate playing experience also includes time with Glenville State and Toledo. In addition to her athletic achievements, she served as a brand ambassador for national brands such as Freddy's Steakburgers and NBA 2K26 by Take Two Interactive during her time as a student-athlete.
Season ticket renewals for the upcoming season are now available online. McGlothan will be entering his third year leading the Eastern Illinois women's basketball program.
